summary: Gate 7 B2, provisional cluster CS-1 + A1, independently: 2 of 8 (Gate 3 wave). Fix preferred by both reporters: give run_apply a sink parameter (the Ctx shape emit_lines already uses) and write each item's audit line, item row and undo rows as the item concludes, stopping the plan on a sink failure; minimum if an independent adjudicator rules I6/MEDIUM: one sentence in README apply limits and the apply definition that rows and manifest arrive only on completion and an interrupted real run leaves neither.
